20	// backendManager is the subset of process.Manager the Gateway depends on.
21	type backendManager interface {
22		Healthy(name string) bool
23		// LoadOrGet returns the backend address for the named model, loading it on
24		// demand if not already running. The caller must call release() when the
25		// proxied request completes to decrement the in-flight counter.
26		LoadOrGet(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) (addr string, release func(), err error)
27		// ListModels returns all known models in non-idle states.

31	// Gateway is an HTTP reverse-proxy that routes OpenAI-compatible requests to llama-server processes.
32	type Gateway struct {
33		cfg      *config.Config
34		mgr      backendManager
35		log      *slog.Logger
36		affinity *affinityTable
37		server   *http.Server
38	}

40	// New creates a Gateway backed by the given process manager.
41	// hub may be nil; when non-nil, /monitor and /monitor/ws routes are registered.
42	func New(cfg *config.Config, mgr *process.Manager, hub *monitor.Hub, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
43		return newGateway(cfg, mgr, hub, log)
44	}

46	func newGateway(cfg *config.Config, mgr backendManager, hub *monitor.Hub, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
47		// Build affinity table from warmup models.
48		modelSlots := make(map[string]int, len(cfg.Warmup))
49		for _, name := range cfg.Warmup {
50			if params, ok := cfg.MatchModel(name); ok {
51				modelSlots[name] = params.Slots
52			}
53		}
54	
55		g := &Gateway{cfg: cfg, mgr: mgr, log: log, affinity: newAffinityTable(modelSlots)}
56	
57		mux := http.NewServeMux()
58		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/chat/completions", g.handleRoute)
59		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/completions", g.handleRoute)
60		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/embeddings", g.handleRoute)
61		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/rerank", g.handleRoute)
62		mux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/models", g.handleModels)
63		mux.HandleFunc("GET /health", g.handleHealth)
64	
65		if hub != nil {
66			mux.HandleFunc("GET /monitor", monitor.HandlePage)
67			mux.HandleFunc("GET /monitor/ws", monitor.HandleWS(hub))
68		}
69	
70		g.server = &http.Server{Addr: cfg.Listen, Handler: mux}
71		return g
72	}

74	// ListenAndServe starts the HTTP server and shuts it down when ctx is cancelled.
75	func (g *Gateway) ListenAndServe(ctx context.Context) error {
76		errCh := make(chan error, 1)
77		go func() {
78			if err := g.server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
79				errCh <- err
80			}
81		}()
82		select {
83		case err := <-errCh:
84			return err
85		case <-ctx.Done():
86			shutCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
87			defer cancel()
88			return g.server.Shutdown(shutCtx)
89		}
90	}

92	// handleRoute extracts the model field from the JSON body and proxies to the matching process.
93	// If the model is known but not loaded, it is started on demand; the HTTP connection
94	// is held open until the model becomes healthy.
95	func (g *Gateway) handleRoute(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
96		// Tee the body so the decoder and the upstream both see it.
97		var captured bytes.Buffer
98		tee := io.TeeReader(r.Body, &captured)
99		dec := json.NewDecoder(tee)
100	
101		var payload struct {
102			Model string `json:"model"`
103		}
104		if err := dec.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
105			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "invalid JSON: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
106			return
107		}
108		if payload.Model == "" {
109			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "missing model field", "bad_request")
110			return
111		}
112	
113		// Reconstruct full body: captured bytes (read by decoder) + rest not yet read.
114		r.Body = io.NopCloser(io.MultiReader(&captured, r.Body))
115	
116		params, ok := g.cfg.MatchModel(payload.Model)
117		if !ok {
118			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "invalid_request_error", "unknown model: "+payload.Model, "model_not_found")
119			return
120		}
121	
122		// LoadOrGet blocks until the model is healthy (or fails). The load context is
123		// detached from the caller's request context inside the manager, so a client
124		// disconnect does not abort an in-progress load that other requests may share.
125		addr, release, err := g.mgr.LoadOrGet(r.Context(), payload.Model, params)
126		if err != nil {
127			if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
128				writeError(w, http.StatusGatewayTimeout, "server_error", "model load timed out: "+err.Error(), "load_timeout")
129				return
130			}
131			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_error", err.Error(), "model_not_loaded")
132			return
133		}
134		defer release()
135	
136		// Register affinity entry for the newly loaded model (idempotent for warmup models).
137		g.affinity.Register(payload.Model, params.Slots)
138	
139		// Slot affinity: read full body, compute prefix hash, inject id_slot if assigned.
140		// On any error, fall through with the original body unchanged.
141		if allBody, readErr := io.ReadAll(r.Body); readErr == nil {
142			hash := prefixHash(allBody)
143			if slotID, assigned := g.affinity.Assign(payload.Model, hash); assigned {
144				allBody = injectSlot(allBody, slotID)
145			}
146			r.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(allBody))
147			r.ContentLength = int64(len(allBody))
148		}
149	
150		target, parseErr := url.Parse(addr)
151		if parseErr != nil {
152			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "invalid backend URL", "internal_error")
153			return
154		}
155	
156		proxy := &httputil.ReverseProxy{
157			Rewrite: func(pr *httputil.ProxyRequest) {
158				pr.SetURL(target)
159				pr.Out.Host = target.Host
160			},
161			FlushInterval: -1,
162			ErrorHandler: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, err error) {
163				g.log.Error("proxy error", "model", payload.Model, "error", err)
164				writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "server_error", "upstream error: "+err.Error(), "upstream_error")
165			},
166		}
167	
168		proxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
169	}

171	// handleModels returns all known models with their current status.
172	func (g *Gateway) handleModels(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
173		type modelObj struct {
174			ID      string `json:"id"`
175			Object  string `json:"object"`
176			OwnedBy string `json:"owned_by"`
177			Status  string `json:"status,omitempty"`
178		}
179		type modelsResp struct {
180			Object string     `json:"object"`
181			Data   []modelObj `json:"data"`
182		}
183	
184		models := g.mgr.ListModels()
185		data := make([]modelObj, len(models))
186		for i, mi := range models {
187			data[i] = modelObj{
188				ID:      mi.ID,
189				Object:  "model",
190				OwnedBy: "wire",
191				Status:  mi.Status,
192			}
193		}
194	
195		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
196		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(modelsResp{Object: "list", Data: data}) //nolint:errcheck
197	}
198	
199	// handleHealth returns 200 if at least one warmup model is healthy, 503 otherwise.
200	func (g *Gateway) handleHealth(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
201		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
202		for _, name := range g.cfg.Warmup {
203			if g.mgr.Healthy(name) {
204				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
205				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "ok"}) //nolint:errcheck
206				return
207			}
208		}
209		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
210		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "degraded"}) //nolint:errcheck
211	}
212	
213	// writeError writes an OpenAI-format JSON error response.
214	func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, errType, message, code string) {
215		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
216		w.WriteHeader(status)
217		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{ //nolint:errcheck
218			"error": map[string]any{
219				"message": message,
220				"type":    errType,
221				"code":    code,
222			},
223		})
224	}

3	import (

10	// ParsePrometheusGauges parses gauge values from Prometheus text format.
11	// Only scalar gauge lines are extracted; labels are stripped from metric names.
12	// Returns map[metric_name]float64.
13	func ParsePrometheusGauges(text string) map[string]float64 {
14		result := make(map[string]float64)
15		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(strings.NewReader(text))
16		for scanner.Scan() {
17			line := scanner.Text()
18			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
19				continue
20			}
21			// Format: metric_name[{labels}] value [timestamp]
22			fields := strings.Fields(line)
23			if len(fields) < 2 {
24				continue
25			}
26			name := fields[0]
27			if i := strings.IndexByte(name, '{'); i >= 0 {
28				name = name[:i]
29			}
30			val, err := strconv.ParseFloat(fields[1], 64)
31			if err != nil {
32				continue
33			}
34			result[name] = val
35		}
36		return result
37	}

39	// SlotState is the run state of a llama-server slot.
40	type SlotState int
41	
42	const (
43		SlotIdle       SlotState = 0
44		SlotProcessing SlotState = 1
45	)
46	
47	// Slot is one element from the GET /slots JSON response.
48	type Slot struct {
49		ID              int       `json:"-"`
50		State           SlotState `json:"-"`
51		NCtx            int       `json:"n_ctx"`
52		NPredict        int       `json:"n_predict"`
53		Prompt          string    `json:"prompt"`
54		TokensPredicted int       `json:"-"`
55		TokensEvaluated int       `json:"-"`
56	}
57	
58	// slotJSON is the raw JSON shape from llama-server /slots.
59	// The format changed: state (int) → is_processing (bool),
60	// tokens_predicted/tokens_evaluated → next_token[].n_decoded.
61	type slotJSON struct {
62		ID           int  `json:"id"`
63		NCtx         int  `json:"n_ctx"`
64		IsProcessing bool `json:"is_processing"`
65	
66		// New format: n_decoded lives inside next_token array.
67		NextToken []struct {
68			NDecoded int `json:"n_decoded"`
69		} `json:"next_token"`
70	}
71	
72	// ParseSlots decodes a /slots JSON response.
73	func ParseSlots(data []byte) ([]Slot, error) {
74		var raw []slotJSON
75		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
76			return nil, err
77		}
78		slots := make([]Slot, len(raw))
79		for i, r := range raw {
80			state := SlotIdle
81			if r.IsProcessing {
82				state = SlotProcessing
83			}
84			decoded := 0
85			if len(r.NextToken) > 0 {
86				decoded = r.NextToken[0].NDecoded
87			}
88			slots[i] = Slot{
89				ID:              r.ID,
90				State:           state,
91				NCtx:            r.NCtx,
92				TokensPredicted: decoded,
93			}
94		}
95		return slots, nil
96	}
